name: featureUpdateProfiles
description: Windows feature update profiles with their target version, end of support date and rollout settings (beta API)

metadata.name: supportState
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['endOfSupportDate']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); if (isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901) { return 'Unknown'; } const days = (t - Date.now()) / 86400000; return days < 0 ? 'End of support' : days <= 90 ? 'Ending soon' : 'Supported'; })() }}

metadata.name: statusRank
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['endOfSupportDate']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); if (isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901) { return 2; } const days = (t - Date.now()) / 86400000; return days < 0 ? 0 : days <= 90 ? 1 : 3; })() }}

metadata.name: endOfSupport
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['endOfSupportDate']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : d; })() }}

metadata.name: daysUntilEndOfSupport
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['endOfSupportDate']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : Math.floor((t - Date.now()) / 86400000); })() }}
